psychology: Miller/chunking — 16 controls grouped into 4 capsule pods keeps each scan target within working-memory limits; the standout, well-executed move
Jakob's Law — coloured traffic lights + unified toolbar mimic macOS-native chrome so users feel at home (conventional interface)
Von Restorff (violated/unused) — no single tool or the export action is promoted; all icons render at identical black weight, so nothing is pre-attentively emphasized
Hick's Law — a tool palette is a browse/expert surface where density is a feature; pod grouping still shortens the scan without thinning options
